interpretation: The wide default VCP stream yields weakly positive fixed-40-day selection Alpha (+0.23 percent) but only three of seven training years are positive, so the pre-registered four-year stability gate fails and selection_supported is false.

The pool is defensive: fixed-40-day excess is positive in down markets (+2.30 percent) and flat in sideways markets, but negative in up markets (-1.58 percent). It is a relative-strength/defensive candidate stream rather than a market-capture stream.
Default exits destroy the selection edge: realized held excess is -0.72 percent versus +0.23 percent fixed-40-day, with no stop-loss exits and all exits via signal or end-of-path.
The right tail is material in absolute terms (246 paths above 50 percent MFE, 37 above 100 percent), and concentration is low (largest signal day 18 trades, top-five symbols 2.18 percent of trades).
The cheat entry signal is a small negative subset (156 trades, -2.13 percent 40-day excess) and should not be mixed with the breakout entry in future structural hypotheses.
next_action: Retain the wide VCP stream as a descriptive candidate pool only. Any structural step must first separate selection quality from exit realization on this ledger, then register one exit hypothesis before one entry hypothesis.
